description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CarService"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceArrival" name="Vehicle presented for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceStarted" name="Service started"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairReady" name="Repair ready for payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentConfirmation" name="Payment confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceSuccessful" name="Successful service and next service time"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Service status update"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_App" name="Police app" processRef="Process_App"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car service facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerArrival" name="Present vehicle for service" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceArrival" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceStarted" sourceRef="Task_NotifyServiceStarted" targetRef="CatchEvent_ServiceStarted" messageRef="Message_ServiceStarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceSuccessful" sourceRef="Task_SendSuccessfulService" targetRef="StartEvent_SuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceReminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairReady" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairReady" targetRef="StartEvent_RepairReady" messageRef="Message_RepairReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentRequest" sourceRef="Task_RequestPayment" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PaymentConfirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_App" name="Car service reminder and app payment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SuccessfulService" name="Successful service recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SuccessfulService" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${serviceNecessary}</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether the car is registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" name="Service within 30 days?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ServiceStarted" name="Service started">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceStarted" messageRef="Message_ServiceStarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="CatchEvent_ThirtyDays" name="30 days elapse">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Fine customer"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceStarted" name="Service started"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Customer fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RepairReady" name="Repair ready for payment">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairReady" messageRef="Message_RepairReady"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestPayment" name="Request payment through the app" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePayment" name="Receive payment through the app" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" name="Confirm payment to service facility" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PaymentComplete" name="Payment confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SuccessfulService" targetRef="CatchEvent_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${registered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceWithinThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="CatchEvent_ServiceStarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceOrFine" targetRef="CatchEvent_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ServiceStarted" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceStarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="CatchEvent_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_RepairReady" targetRef="Task_RequestPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestPayment" targetRef="Task_ReceivePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePayment" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_4" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_PaymentComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceArrival" name="Vehicle presented for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceArrival" messageRef="Message_ServiceArrival"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyServiceStarted" name="Notify app that service has started" messageRef="Message_ServiceStarted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" name="Repair and send updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdates" name="Send status updates by email" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" name="Repair and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRepairReady" name="Notify app that repair is ready for payment" messageRef="Message_RepairReady"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" name="Receive payment confirmation" messageRef="Message_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" name="Mechanic enters successful repair and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Mechanic enters time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSuccessfulService" name="Send successful service and next service time to app" messageRef="Message_ServiceSuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ServiceComplete" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceArrival" targetRef="Task_NotifyServiceStarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_2" sourceRef="Task_NotifyServiceStarted" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_3" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_4" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkSplit" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_6" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_7" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceWorkJoin" targetRef="Task_SendRepairReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_9" sourceRef="Task_SendRepairReady" targetRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceivePaymentConfirmation" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_11" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_12" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="Task_SendSuccessfulService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Service_13" sourceRef="Task_SendSuccessfulService" targetRef="EndEvent_ServiceComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
